## Outcome

Describe the user-visible result and why this change is needed.

## Verification

List exact tests, checks, and scenes you ran. For visual changes, attach a
representative frame or short render and state the output settings reviewed.

## Compatibility

Describe public API, dependency, rendering, or migration impact. Write "None"
when there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the Code of Conduct.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` pass.
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes.
- [ ] New example scenes have a one-line teaching-intent class docstring.
- [ ] I reviewed content accuracy and presentation-scale readability for visual changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the `Unreleased` changelog when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] This change contains no secrets, private data, or material we cannot redistribute.
